beat_plan: Establish: overlap deliberate paper-like crops around one product proof
Prove: use an approved local capture or truthful designed-motion detail
Payoff: editorial glue with one clear final identity

direction.camera: Guide attention with cutout image; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: overlap deliberate paper-like crops around one product proof; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with layered paper; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with editorial glue.
direction.lighting: small layered shadows; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: cut paper and photographic print; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around playful juxtaposition; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use cutout image,layered paper,offset crop,tactile collage,playful juxtaposition,editorial glue as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
